headline: African Gaming Startup Rise of Fearless Secures $1M from Epic
summary: African-owned gaming startup Rise of Fearless raised $1 million in funding from Mauritius-based advisory and investment firm Epic to challenge global video game giants.
why: Venture capital investments in emerging market tech startups highlight regional growth trends and expanding digital entertainment markets.

impacts.name: Rise of Fearless
impacts.why: Securing $1 million in funding provides capital for business expansion.
